business_problem: Chanmama needed a better retrieval stack for similar-product recommendation and creator merchandising. Its prior vector-search approach and self-managed Spark cluster struggled with high-dimensional search performance, storage efficiency, frequent vector updates, and cluster operations, which raised cost, slowed offline jobs, and increased failure risk.
solution_summary: Chanmama redesigned its recommendation pipeline around EMR Serverless Spark and Vector Search Service Milvus Edition so product data and embeddings could be processed as a managed, elastic workflow instead of a self-operated cluster. Periodic offline jobs extract product records from StarRocks, including IDs, titles, and descriptions, then use a machine-learning model service to convert product titles into vectors. Serverless Spark combines those vectors with product metadata and batch-loads them into Milvus, which becomes the low-latency similarity-search layer for recommendation and creator product-selection workloads. Because the compute layer is serverless, the team can scale resources only when jobs run; because Milvus is purpose-built for large vector collections, the platform avoids the indexing and storage penalties of the previous search stack. The result is a cheaper, more stable recommendation architecture that matches analyst workflows and recommendation use cases.

solution_components.name: EMR Serverless Spark
solution_components.role: Runs periodic offline jobs that extract product data, create embeddings, and batch-load vector data into the search layer.

solution_components.name: Vector Search Service Milvus Edition
solution_components.role: Stores product vectors and metadata and returns similar-product matches for recommendation and merchandising workflows.

data_flow: Periodic Serverless Spark jobs read product data from StarRocks, call a machine-learning model service to create title embeddings, batch-write vectors and metadata into Milvus, and then expose low-latency similarity search to recommendation and creator product-selection services.
business_outcome: Chanmama reduced vector retrieval cost by 75%, cut offline job runtime by 40%, lowered task failure rates by 80%, and gained an autoscaling, pay-as-you-go recommendation pipeline that is easier to operate and better suited to large product catalogs.
architecture_clues: Serverless Spark jobs are scheduled periodically rather than run on a permanently provisioned cluster.
Milvus is used as the vector storage and similarity-search layer for large-scale recommendation workloads.
The pipeline separates product extraction, embedding generation, vector storage, and serving into distinct stages.

source_references.title: Chanmama uses EMR and Milvus to build an efficient vector retrieval system

evidence_quotes: Chanmama chose Alibaba Cloud EMR Serverless Spark and Milvus to build an engineering solution that matches recommendation and search workflows (original: 为了应对新的业务挑战，蝉妈妈选择与阿里云合作，利用其 EMR Serverless Spark 和 Milvus，构建符合搜索推荐业务场景和数据分析师习惯的工程解决方案).

In Serverless Spark, periodic offline jobs extract product data from StarRocks, call a model service to turn titles into vectors, and batch-write the vectors into Milvus for similarity search (original: 在 Serverless Spark 中，通过周期性的离线任务，从 StarRocks 数据库中提取商品数据... 调用机器学习模型服务，将商品标题转换为向量表示... 批量写入阿里云 Milvus 向量数据库).

The new architecture is suitable for recommendation systems and personalized marketing because it supports large-scale, low-latency similar-product retrieval (original: 该架构支持大规模、低延迟的相似商品检索，适用于推荐系统、个性化营销等应用场景).

Compared with the previous approach, Milvus reduced vector retrieval cost by 75%, while offline task time fell 40% and task failure rate fell 80% (original: 与传统搜索方案相比，阿里云 Milvus 实现向量检索的成本降低了 75%... 离线任务耗时减少 40%... 任务失败率降低 80%).
Because the compute layer is pay-as-you-go and automatically scales, resources are only consumed when tasks run (original: 真正的按量付费，不使用时没有资源消耗；提供多种资源包选择，进一步降低成本).
